entry: [TRADER_DONCHIAN55] Entry candidates need at least 252 daily bars, a positive ATR14, and a positive 20-day average dollar volume. Entry condition: last close above the prior 55-day high (the maximum high of the 55 bars before the last bar) and last close above the 200-day SMA. Candidates are ranked by (close - prior55_high) / ATR14 descending, symbol ascending on ties; slots: 10. The entry intent is market, day, buy_to_open, with stop_price = round(price - 2.0 x ATR14, 4) recorded on the intent (ATR14 is Wilder RMA). Exits are evaluated first; if any exit is emitted, the evaluation returns with no entry.
exit: [TRADER_DONCHIAN55] 1. Exits are evaluated first; if any exit is emitted, the evaluation returns with no entry. 2. Exit, initial stop: a held position whose last close is at or below its recorded stop_price (the entry 2xATR14 stop, read from the position or its meta) is sold in full. 3. Exit, timeout: a position held at least 126 completed holding bars is sold in full (reason `126_completed_holding_bars`). 4. Exit, signals (requires at least 252 bars): a last close below the prior 20-day low and/or below the 200-day SMA sells the position in full, with the triggered conditions named in the reason. entry: [griffith-52w-high-rs] Decision: at the first pass of each month, on the prior month's last SPY bar; the month waits until the tape carries 99% of the names it can. entry: [muse-grok-sr-spy] Zones: fractal swing pivots (5 bars each side) plus volume-at-price nodes (0.10 bins at or above the 90th percentile), clustered into 0.40 to 0.80 point bands; top 6 bands kept; the map is fixed for the session. Fade: price enters a band from outside, prints a rejection wick beyond the far edge of at least 50% of the bar range, and closes back inside the band or beyond its near edge, on volume above 1.5x the trailing 20-bar average. Breakout: a bar closes beyond the far edge by at least 0.10 with body at least 60% of range, volume above the prior bar and at least 1.2x the trailing 20-bar average. At most 3 entries a day; none at or after 11:30 ET.

[muse-grok-sr-spy] 5. Scan (fades first, across all live bands, then breakouts): a fade short fires when the prior close was below the band low, the bar high exceeds the band high, the upper wick is at least 50 percent of the bar range, the close is at or below the band high, and volume is above 1.5 times the trailing average. A fade long is mirrored at the band low. A breakout long fires when the prior close was at or below the band high, the close exceeds the band high by at least 0.10, the body is at least 60 percent of the range, and volume is above the prior bar's volume and at least 1.2 times the trailing average. A breakout short is mirrored at the band
exit: [muse-grok-sr-spy] Stop beyond the band far edge by 0.10; target the nearest band edge in the trade direction or 2R, whichever is closer. - A close back through the band within 3 bars after the fill exits (reclaim invalidation); hard flat at 13:00 ET.

[muse-grok-sr-spy] 7. Management: hard flat first (at or after 13:00 ET, exit in full and mark the band dead). Then the reclaim invalidation: on bar indices entry_index+1 through entry_index+3, a close back through the band (above the band high for a fade short, below the band low for a fade long, back inside the band for a breakout) exits in full at the next open by desk convention, and the band dies. After 3 bars the reclaim rule lapses and the stop, target and hard flat govern (stop and target are carried as exit rules on the entry intent).

entry: [qm-episodic-pivot] Pool: 20-day dollar volume ≥ $5M and a 126-session return ≤ 30%, while QQQ is risk-on. Open: gap ≥ 10% over the last close and first-20-minute volume ≥ 0.5× the 20-day average. Catalyst: a verified 8-K / 6-K public before the trigger minute. Trigger: from minute 20, price crosses the opening-range high; stop = the low before the trigger bar, within 1 ATR.
[qm-episodic-pivot] Buys a quiet stock that gaps up 10% or more on a verified catalyst with heavy early volume, when it takes out the opening-range high from minute 20.
exit: [qm-episodic-pivot] Hard stop at the entry stop. - After the third session held, in profit: sells a third (at the close) and moves the stop to breakeven. - After 3 sessions, a close below the 10-day SMA (the 20-day when the close is more than 1.5 ATR above the 10-day) exits at the next open.

sizing: [qm-episodic-pivot] Book: $100,000. Sizing: 0.35% of the session's opening equity on the stressed loss per share (stop distance + the 95th-percentile adverse overnight gap over 126 sessions + round-trip friction); capped at 20% of equity per name, 100% gross, 25% per sector, 4% total open risk, 1% of 20-day dollar volume, 15 positions.

entry: [apex-o5-chop-harvest] Trend score = the share of 6 bullish votes on the Nasdaq-100 total return (above its 50-, 100- and 200-day averages; up over 63, 126 and 252 days); volatility = a walk-forward HAR forecast of the next 5 days. Core: APEX-50F Nasdaq exposure with its 0.20 band, in QQQ / TQQQ. CHOP: at a month's first session when the trend score is 2, 3 or 4 of 6 votes, sells the call and put 1 σ√T out and buys wings 2 σ√T out (an iron condor), NAV / spot shares a leg, the next monthly expiry ≥ 15 days out.

[apex-o5-chop-harvest] 2. CHOP entry: at a month's first session, when the trend score is 2, 3 or 4 of 6 votes (code: round(trend[t-1] x 6) in (2,3,4)) and no chop legs are held: sell the call and the put 1 sigma sqrt(T) out and buy wings 2 sigma sqrt(T) out (an iron condor), NAV / spot shares a leg, on the next monthly expiry at least 15 days out. Code strikes: calls/puts at spot x e^(+1w) / e^(-1w) sold, spot x e^(+2w) / e^(-2w) bought, where w = sigma sqrt(T) with sigma the at-the-money implied vol.

entry: [opt-qqq95-rsi2] Buys the QQQ core once: 95% of initial capital at the ask. Overlay: the RSI2 recovery signal (close > SMA200, RSI(2) < 10), 09:35-09:40 ET, 14-21 DTE calls of delta 0.50-0.60.

[opt-qqq95-rsi2] 7. Debit and gates: Long premium check: reject if debit / spot is above 0.015 (the code tests (debit x 100) / (spot x 100) against max_premium_spot 0.015), where debit is the long leg ask. Reject a debit at or below 0. Core spread gate (enhancement, on by default): refuse if the long leg ask minus bid is above 25% of its ask.
exit: [opt-qqq95-rsi2] Overlay: exit on the 5th session counting the entry day, or on a 2% touch of the underlying; the core is held.

[opt-qqq95-rsi2] 1. Exits first, for held positions that carry option legs. In order: (a) pre-expiry guard: exit if the first leg expiry is 1 day or less from the current session; (b) planned session exit: exit if sessions held is at or above 5 (sessions held is taken from the position, or counted from daily bars after the entry date); (c) touch exit (exit_rule 'touch'): exit if the underlying last daily close is at or above entry_spot x 1.02. An exit is a full sell_to_close package reversing the legs. A position with no legs (the QQQ equity core) is skipped: there is no exit rule for it.

entry: [mk-dailybilbobox] Squeeze (Saty's compression): the 21-day, 2-sd Bollinger band inside 2 × ATR(14) around EMA(21), not while the gap widens inside 1.854 × ATR. Box: the high and low of a squeeze's first 5 bars (fewer if it ends sooner), locked at the 5th bar or at its end. For 20 bars after the lock: buys when the high reaches the box high with the prior close above EMA(21) (short: the low through the box low, the prior close below EMA21), at max(open, box high); void once the other side is reached first. One trade at a time per symbol and side. Stocks trade only while their 20-day mean dollar volume is ≥ $5M and the close ≥ $3.

[mk-dailybilbobox] Boxes the first 5 days of a daily squeeze, buys a break above the box (shorts a break below) and trails the stop along the 50-day EMA. Note on the card: a related long-only desk sleeve trades this box with a nowcast arm and earnings exits; that sleeve is a different strategy and is not this package.
exit: [mk-dailybilbobox] Stop at the box's other side, ratcheted each bar to the prior bar's EMA(50), never back; the entry bar stops only on a close through it; out after 250 bars.

strategies.creator: William O'Neil's follow-through day, as coded by the Milkman v2 study

entry: [mk-oneilfollowthroughdayrace] Correction: a close 10% under the highest close of the last 63; the lowest low since is the correction low. Rally: the first up close is day 1; a low under day 1's low restarts the count; from day 4, a close up ≥ 1.25% on higher volume than the day before is the follow-through day; enters at its close. A close back within 0.1% of the 63-day high resets it.

[mk-oneilfollowthroughdayrace] 2. Rally: the first up close is day 1; a low under day 1's low restarts the count; from day 4, a close up >= 1.25% on higher volume than the day before is the follow-through day; enter at its close. Distance = close - correction low.
exit: [mk-oneilfollowthroughdayrace] Long: target close + (close - correction low), stop the correction low. Short: target the correction low, stop close + the same distance. From the next bar, stop first; else out at the close after 120 sessions.

[mk-oneilfollowthroughdayrace] 4. Exit, long row: target close + distance, stop the correction low. Short row: target the correction low, stop close + distance. From the next bar, stop is checked first; otherwise exit at the close after 120 sessions.

[mk-oneilfollowthroughdayrace] - Long: target close + (close - correction low), stop the correction low. Short: target the correction low, stop close + the same distance. From the next bar, stop first; else out at the close after 120 sessions.
sizing: [mk-oneilfollowthroughdayrace] 5. Sizing: Close rules are decided 15 to 11 minutes before the close on the bar so far and sent market-on-close; level touches trade at the market when seen; signals of the completed bar trade at the next open. $10,000 a trade on a $1,000,000 book, every signal taken; each lane keeps its own trades and the sleeve trades the net per symbol. Futures lanes trade on a simulated venue quoted from Yahoo, or are only recorded where that venue has no quote.

entry: [mk-milkmancryptolinkedstockvariant] Rules: Connors Double 7 (7, SMA200), Legend's Buy Day overnight (3), Daily Bilbo Box (5, EMA50 trail), Swing and Multi-day Golden Gates, EMA21 deviation (2 ATR, 10 sessions), Phase Oscillator accumulation (20 sessions), Pivot Ribbon 13/48, compression expansion (10 bars, 5 sessions); each long and short. Names: the crypto-linked stock list's symbols among the 1,822 stocks (134). Stocks trade only while their 20-day mean dollar volume is ≥ $5M and the close ≥ $3.
[mk-milkmancryptolinkedstockvariant] Runs nine of the study's daily rules, long and short, on 134 crypto-linked US stocks.
exit: [mk-milkmancryptolinkedstockvariant] Each rule exits by its own rule: a 7-day closing extreme, the next open, the EMA50 trail, a gate target, stop or period end, an EMA21 touch, a fixed hold, the opposite cross.

sizing: [mk-milkmancryptolinkedstockvariant] 4. Sizing: Close rules are decided 15 to 11 minutes before the close on the bar so far and sent market-on-close; level touches trade at the market when seen; signals of the completed bar trade at the next open. $10,000 a trade on a $1,000,000 book, every signal taken; each lane keeps its own trades and the sleeve trades the net per symbol. Repair test on the last 4 bars: balance[-1] - balance[0] >= 2; at least 2 of the 7 vote channels strictly increase across at least one adjacent transition in the panel; total_votes == 7 at both panel ends; the latest row's native status, when present, must be "ready". Price/volume gates on the latest panel row: close >= 5, dollar_volume20 >= 1,000,000, atr14 > 0. Warmup: the current bar index + 1 must be >= 234 (minimum source bars). Cooldown: 20 native bars after an entry (the sleeve's state file records next_eligible_bar_index = entry bar index
exit: [tensor-state-repair] The only designed exit is time: a position is sold in full when the current panel bar index minus its entry bar index reaches 20 native bars (late observation still exits). The exit price is the latest bar close on the sleeve's timeframe when available. - No price stop and no profit target in the source policy.

entry: [mk-bigwinners] Weekly fire: a closed weekly Tensor bar with a buy-cyan or buy-green marker (bar ≥ 60). Stream: 20-day dollar volume ≥ $1M; not avoided (price ≥ $100; Cyan within 5% of the 52-week high; XLF, XLB, XLRE; Cyan in XLU; Green within 13 weeks of the name's last fire); calibrated (Cyan: ≤ $14.94 or a 60-week depth ≥ 70.35%; Green: ≤ $13.15 with a 20-week standard deviation of weekly returns ≥ 0.08896). Order: the desk score (5.5, plus up to 1 for the calibration boosts when dollar volume ≥ $2M), then dollar volume; one position per name. Budget: open cost basis ≤ $50,000 less realised losses. Bought at the market in the first 90 minutes of the session after the fire (one session late at most), at
[mk-bigwinners] Buys $1,000 of every liquid, calibrated weekly Tensor Cyan / Green fire, one per name, holds 52 weeks, inside a $50,000 budget (strategy card).
exit: [mk-bigwinners] At the close of the 52nd week after the fire week, market-on-close.

Entry trigger = level(0.236) minus $0.01 (bearish) / plus $0.01 (bullish). Entry gates: latest b

entry: [TRADER_SQUEEZE20] Squeeze definition (period 20): Bollinger Bands BB(20, 2, population stdev) around the 20-period SMA; Keltner Channel KC(20, 1.5 x ATR) around EMA(20) with Wilder/RMA ATR; a bar is in squeeze when the BB lower band is above the KC lower band and the BB upper band is below the KC upper band. Momentum is the LazyBear momentum: the linear-regression endpoint of the last 20 values of delta, where delta = close - ((20-bar high/low midpoint + SMA20) / 2). Entry (all must hold on a completed daily bar): the prior bar was in squeeze and the current bar is not; momentum > 0 and momentum > the prior bar's momentum; close > the prior 20-day high (the maximum high of the 20 bars before the current bar).
exit: [TRADER_SQUEEZE20] 2. Entry (all must hold on a completed daily bar): the prior bar was in squeeze and the current bar is not; momentum > 0 and momentum > the prior bar's momentum; close > the prior 20-day high (the maximum high of the 20 bars before the current bar). Features require at least 252 daily bars, and the desk port drops bars dated the current session from the feature set (completed-bar rule). 3. Exit (first that fires): close < EMA20 (the Keltner centre); momentum <= 0; the initial 2 x ATR(14) stop is touched (the bar's low against the stop price recorded at entry, entry close minus 2 x ATR(14)); or 20 completed holding bars.

entry: [bta_onebar_qqq] If the latest completed bar's high is at or above the channel high, a long entry fills at the channel high, or at that bar's open if the bar opened above the channel high. If the latest bar's low is at or below the channel low, a short entry fills at the channel low, or at that bar's open if it opened below it. If the bar spans both extremes, no entry. One position at a time. An entry is counted on the entry bar's ET date; at most 2 entries per day, and entries are only taken on the current session's bars. (docs/BTA-ONEBAR-ALGORITHM.md, Algorithm 1 step 2)
exit: [bta_onebar_qqq] Protective stop: Long: entry x 0.998. Short: entry x 1.002. No target, no trailing rule. Time exit: a position entered on bar T exits in full at the open of bar T+1, at market, with the closing position intent (sell_to_close for a long, buy_to_close for a short). No re-entry in the same bar as an exit. (docs/BTA-ONEBAR-ALGORITHM.md, Algorithm 1 steps 4-5)
sizing: [bta_onebar_qqq] qty = floor(slice equity / entry price), whole shares. If the live snapshot carries no slice, the configured $10,000 slice is used. The $10,000 slice is the notional cap and the binding sizing constraint. (docs/BTA-ONEBAR-ALGORITHM.md, Algorithm 1 step 3 and translation table)
filters: [bta_onebar_qqq] Channel gate: the prior 50 completed bars before the latest completed bar; fewer than 51 completed bars in total: no action. No filters and no other rules (family summary). data: 30-minute bars from the desk warm product (Alpaca SIP); inputs bars, bars_30min, bars:QQQ:30Min, positions, quotes, session_fills.
